title: Amiga historical source discovery
summary: Screen Amiga source preservation repositories and add 11 distinct projects.
notes: Personally screened the preservation collection and compared candidates against the current tracker. These are preserved original sources, not claims of reverse engineering. Quarterback includes later restoration work. No independent builds or execution.

sources.reason: A preserved Modula-2 mathematics and page-layout application, combining function analysis, graphing and desktop publishing.
Preserved 68k assembly source for an Amiga graphics conversion application. The README says the artpro.i include is missing.
Original Canux DesignWorks source released for historical preservation, recovered from floppy disks and containing version 1 and work-in-progress version 2.
Canux Disk-2-Disk source, recovered from floppy disks and released for historical preservation, with versions 2.1 and 2.2. No functionality beyond the source archive is asserted.
Canux Dos-2-Dos source, recovered from floppy disks and released for historical preservation, with multiple version directories.
Canux Mac-2-Dos source and macfloppydevice source, recovered from floppy disks and released for historical preservation.
Canux ProFonts source, recovered from floppy disks and released for historical preservation; the archive classifies it under text/print.
Canux SuperDuper CCS source, recovered from floppy disks and released for historical preservation; the archive classifies it under disk/misc.
Original Quarterback 6.0.1 and Quarterback Tools Deluxe 2.0.2 C source, released under GPL and updated with build scripts and changes by Olaf Barthel.
Preserved source for an Amiga backup and restore utility supporting full and selective backups, archive files and non-AmigaDOS partitions.
Preserved source for a one- or two-player hexagonal board game for Amiga Workbench.
